{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Clean revenue: remove commas and convert to float
df['revenue_clean'] = df['revenue'].str.replace(',', '').astype(float)

# Identify internal test orders: revenue_clean == 999999.99
# We now know there are 6 such rows

# Filter out test orders
non_test_orders = df[df['revenue_clean'] != 999999.99]

# Filter for completed orders
completed_orders = non_test_orders[non_test_orders['status'] == 'completed']

# Calculate total revenue from completed orders, excluding test orders
total_revenue = completed_orders['revenue_clean'].sum()

total_revenue"}
